header: The facts of an event as a short specification
subheader: Date, time, place, price, language, capacity — beside a picture.
lead: The rows are a definition list rather than a styled grid, so a screen reader is told which half of each pair is the term and which is the value.
note: Dates are editorial strings, not date fields: write the year out so a band left up too long is obviously out of date.

facts.title: Value
facts.text: Long enough for a date, short enough to stay on one line.

facts.title: Second line
facts.text: Each row can carry a supporting sentence like this one.
